resolved_source_issues.issue: The moving-wedge board derivation momentarily used the wrong sign for the relative-coordinate force.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter derives partial L/partial x=-mg directly from L=T-V.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The double-pendulum board mixed plus and minus conventions for the relative angle.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter fixes one geometry and uses theta+alpha consistently, while explicitly preserving the classroom correction.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The lecture informally treated the velocity-to-momentum map as always invertible.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter states the regular Legendre condition and notes that singular constrained or gauge systems require additional machinery.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The direction of oscillator phase-space circulation can be misread from a static board sketch.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The text derives the tangent vector (omega p,-omega q), so the direction follows from the equations rather than the drawing.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The closing list of frontier problems was spoken in 2011.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The chapter preserves the list and labels it as historical context rather than a current-status claim.
